# GRE 8-Week Preparation Plan

A realistic plan built around **90 minutes on weekdays**, **3 hours on Saturdays**, and **no Sundays**. It prioritizes **quantitative reasoning**, keeps **vocabulary to 15 minutes daily**, and adds **weekly review checkpoints** so you can adjust before gaps grow.

# Weekly Study Roadmap

| Week | Focus | Weekday Structure | Saturday Block | Review Checkpoint |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Diagnostic + foundations | 15m vocab; 45m quant basics; 30m verbal/reading | 1h quant diagnostic review; 1h algebra/number properties; 1h timed practice | Baseline score, error log started |
| 2 | Arithmetic + data interpretation | 15m vocab; 50m quant drills; 25m verbal; 10m review | 1h arithmetic; 1h data interpretation; 1h mixed set | Accuracy by topic, pacing check |
| 3 | Algebra focus | 15m vocab; 55m quant; 20m verbal; 10m review | 1h equations/inequalities; 1h word problems; 1h timed section | Midpoint quiz, weakest subtopics ranked |
| 4 | Geometry + mixed practice | 15m vocab; 45m geometry; 30m verbal; 15m review | 1h geometry; 1h mixed quant; 1h verbal set | Quant timing and careless-error review |
| 5 | Advanced quant + stamina | 15m vocab; 60m quant timed sets; 15m review | 1h mixed hard quant; 1h full verbal section; 1h review | Full-length practice section score |
| 6 | Full-section practice | 15m vocab; 45m quant; 30m verbal; 15m review | 1h timed quant section; 1h timed verbal section; 1h deep review | Section-level pacing and endurance |
| 7 | Test simulation | 15m vocab; 40m quant; 25m verbal; 20m review | 2h mini mock test; 1h review and corrections | Final weakness list, last-target topics |
| 8 | Final polish + taper | 15m vocab; 45m light quant; 20m verbal; 10m review | 1h mixed review; 1h formula/strategy refresh; 1h confidence set | Final readiness check, light final-day plan |

# Daily Study Template by Weekday

## Monday to Friday
- **15 min** — Vocabulary review
- **45–60 min** — Quantitative reasoning main work
- **15–30 min** — Verbal reading, text completion, or sentence equivalence
- **10–15 min** — Error log, formula review, or recap

## Saturday
- **3 hours total**
- Best use:
  - 60 min: focused quant topic
  - 60 min: timed mixed practice
  - 30 min: verbal practice
  - 30 min: review mistakes and update weak areas

## Sunday
- No study
- Keep the day off to avoid burnout and improve retention

# Week-by-Week Focus

## Week 1: Set the baseline
- Take a diagnostic quant and verbal set
- Identify the top 3 quant weaknesses
- Build your error log and formula sheet
- Keep practice lighter and more diagnostic than intense

## Week 2: Arithmetic and data interpretation
- Work on fractions, ratios, percentages, and decimals
- Add charts, tables, and data comparison questions
- Start timing yourself on small sets

## Week 3: Algebra
- Linear equations, inequalities, exponents, and word problems
- Focus on translating words into equations
- Review common traps and answer choices

## Week 4: Geometry
- Triangles, circles, lines, area, volume, and coordinate geometry
- Mix geometry with earlier quant topics
- Check whether mistakes are conceptual or careless

## Week 5: Harder quant and speed
- Increase timed sets
- Mix topics instead of studying one type only
- Push for better pacing without sacrificing accuracy

## Week 6: Full sections
- Do full GRE-style quant and verbal sections
- Review every missed question carefully
- Track whether mistakes come from time pressure, concept gaps, or misreading

## Week 7: Simulation week
- Take at least one mini mock test under realistic timing
- Practice switching between quant and verbal efficiently
- Refine test-day strategy and section pacing

## Week 8: Final review
- Reduce heavy new learning
- Revisit formulas, common traps, and your error log
- Keep practice sharp but lighter to stay fresh

# Review Checkpoints

## End of Every Week
- Review your **error log**
- Rework missed quant problems without looking at solutions
- Note the 2 most persistent weak topics
- Adjust next week’s Saturday block accordingly

## Midpoint Checkpoint: End of Week 4
- Take a timed mixed quant set
- Compare accuracy against Week 1 baseline
- Decide whether to increase quant time further or shift more time to verbal

## Final Checkpoint: End of Week 7
- Confirm pacing, stamina, and confidence
- Identify only the last 2–3 weak areas
- Keep Week 8 light and focused on retention

# Quick Actions
